label: SQLite
description: Query a SQLite database file on this machine.
usage_notes: Open the file named by `database_path` read-only, through a URI: `sqlite3.connect(f"file:{path}?mode=ro", uri=True)`. Never open it for writing and never copy it to change it. List the tables with `SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'`.

form.title: Connect SQLite
form.subtitle: Point Anton at a SQLite database file on this machine.

fields.description: Absolute path to the SQLite file.
